lines.text: Heavenly spheres turn, in endless return
The river of stars gleams, as if from within
Sun and moon in their courses, as if from within
Beneath life’s multitudes, above the boundless cosmos
A mayfly to heaven and earth, a mote in the sea
True meaning abides, words fall away
Heaven and earth arise with me, all things are one
Heaven keeps its course, not by sages kept nor by tyrants undone
Cold comes then heat goes, autumn gathers winter stores
We read the sky above, we read the earth below
Stars hang over the plain, the moon swells the river
The Milky Way seems near, how far are we apart
Sunlight and moonshine, day after day
Wind walks the water, grasses and trees glow
Things alter and stars shift, the seasons turn on
Over the vast sea the moon shines, pearls keep hidden tears
Heaven and earth stand clear, the four seasons wheel
Dawn yields to dusk, the cosmos breathes on
The Dipper wheels slowly, the night opens wide
We pass through this world, like a white foal through a gap
Happy the moment, when we are seated
In the palace, thou and I
With two forms and two figures,
But with one soul, thou and I
The colours of the grove,
And the voice of the birds, will bestow immortality
When we come into the garden, thou and I
The stars of heaven, will come to gaze upon us
We shall show them,
The moon itself, thou and I
Thou and I individuals no more,
Shall be mingled in ecstasy, joyful
And secure from foolish babble, thou and I
All the bright-plumed birds of heaven, will devour their hearts with envy
In the place where we shall laugh,
In such a fashion, thou and I
This is the greatest wonder,
That thou and I,
Sitting here in the same nook, are at this moment
Both in ’Iraq and Khorasan, thou and I
Out of Darkness
Listen to my voice
Calling you
Pulling you out of darkness
Hear the devil's cry of sin
Always turn your back on him
With the wind you go
Still I dream of your spirit
leading you back home
I will give my gifts to you
Grow your garden, watch it bloom
The light in your eyes
is an angel up high
Fighting to ease the shadow side
Hearts will grow though having to bend
Leaving behind all things in the end
Listen to my voice
Calling you
Pulling you out of darkness
Hear the devil's cry of sin
Always turn your back on him
